en.topic_title: Hong Kong cinema takes spotlight at Taiwan’s Golden Horse film awards
en.topic_summary:
Two films inspired by Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement won gongs at Taiwan’s Golden Horse Awards on Sunday, with one acceptance speech dedicated to “those in prison”.



Hong Kong actress Angela Yuen poses for photos after winning Best Leading Actress for the movie ”Afterpiece” at Taiwan’s 63rd Golden Horse film awards ceremony, in Taipei on November 22, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng/AFP.
